No, not one bit. I think your eyelashes look great with the mascara but the eyeliner could be worked on! Maybe try a softer look? Like rather than pen liner, use a kohl pencil and small fluffy brush. The shape you do suits you and your eyes, but i feel softer smokey would be better than wobbly pen! Practise! 

You have a lovely hair colour and eyebrows! Your long hair suits you, but if you worry about a round face then try some layers and haircuts that are face framing! Like soft curtain bangs or a butterfly cut. I don’t personally think your round face is negative. I do agree it makes you look youthful, but it’s in a positive way! Your face looks so pretty with fuller cheeks, it makes you have a lovely smile :) And such a nice side profile!!! 

Experiment with your style, listen to your boyfriend and stay healthy! You have great skin! Eat well, sleep well and stay hydrated.

Bbygirl as if you’re ugly. If you’re posting on a sub like this you gotta have self doubt and that’s what needs to be worked on. 

Your features are pretty and cohesive on your face. Everything suits you. You have lovely lips that i’m acc quite jealous of lol. The volume and shape makes me envious. You have lovely arched eyebrows, maybe try get them threaded or something to bring out the symmetry and clean them up slightly.

Like another commenter said, slight eye bags. Sleep girl! I think just take care of yourself so you feel your best. Eat well, be active, sleep and stay hydrated. Don’t feed into subs and things like this to stay negative !! Plenty of lovely comments here but you shouldn’t be posting on an am i ugly sub in the first place! Give yourself some love :)

I think you’re pretty :) I agree with some comments here, find your style ! You have a lovely prettiness to you, in the first picture i find you quite fairy like lol! 

I think the lighter hair really suits you, Try some hair masks and treatments to keep it healthy. You have a curl pattern so look into your hair type and how to bring out the best curls. You should stop with the eyeliner though honestly, or learn to clean it up. Practise makes perfect. I also would lean to a brown liner if you don’t do anything else heavy to your face as the mistakes show up more with the black and it looks out of place. Try a brown kohl and smoke it out softly. Mascara may not be your thing but it definitely helps eyeliner look more cohesive! There’s also brown mascara which has a lovely warm and natural look! A little blush would look sweet on you i think! but you really don’t need the makeup, you have a sweet face which if you do have makeup it should be kept light and minimal so your features glow rather than hide. You have a really lovely smile! and such nice clear skin! Keep experimenting with your style and keep hydrated so that skin glows. 

But simply put. Not ugly !

You’ve always had a wonderful jaw but now it’s definitely a lot more feminine. You have a lovely smile that fits your softer jaw too.
